title: Bo Nix vs. Drew Brees — How Real Is the Comp? Plus Waddle Putting on a Show | Orange & Blue Today
text: On Thursday’s Orange & Blue Today, Cecil Lammey goes solo to break down one of the spiciest quotes of camp so far — Sean Payton comparing Bo Nix to Drew Brees. How apt is the comparison. title: Broncos Camp Opens — Sean Payton Sets the Tone, How Did Bo Nix Look? | Orange & Blue Today
